goals.name: Learn English
goals.description: men hozir elementary darajasidaman menda speakng yomon shuni to'g'irlash uchun qo'ydim

tasks.text: Kun 1: 5x5 barbell squat, 4x8 bench press, 3x12 pull-ups, 20 minut cardio
Kun 2: 4x6 deadlift, 3x10 overhead press, 3x15 dumbbell rows, 15 minut interval sprint
Kun 3: Aktif tiklanish – yengil yugurish 30 daqiqa, cho'zish va mobilitet mashqlari
Kun 4: 4x8 leg press, 3x12 incline dumbbell press, 3x10 lat pulldown, 3x15 ab roller
Kun 5: 5x5 barbell row, 4x8 dips, 3x12 Romanian deadlift, 20 minut HIIT
Kun 6: Aktif tiklanish – suzish yoki velosiped 30 daqiqa, yoga va cho'zish
Kun 7: 4x10 goblet squat, 3x12 dumbbell shoulder press, 3x15 cable fly, 3x20 plank (1 daqiqa)
Basic greetings and self-introduction practice: repeat aloud common greetings and introduce yourself using simple sentences.
Listen to a short beginner dialogue (2‑3 minutes) and repeat each sentence, focusing on pronunciation and intonation.
Learn 20 everyday nouns (e.g., food, objects) and describe each one with a simple sentence aloud.
Shadowing exercise: play a 1‑minute audio clip and speak simultaneously, trying to match the speaker's rhythm.
Record yourself answering three basic questions (name, age, hobby) and compare with a native speaker model.
Practice common question patterns (What is...?, Where is...?, How many...?) by forming and speaking 5 questions and answers.
Watch a beginner YouTube video (2‑3 min) and retell the main idea in your own words, speaking for at least 30 seconds.
Role‑play a simple shop scenario: buyer and seller dialogues, focusing on polite expressions and correct stress.
Learn 10 common verbs in present simple and create short spoken sentences for each.
Join a language exchange app for 10 minutes and practice speaking with a partner using the topics you studied this week.

roadmap_steps.title: Maqsadni aniqlash
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Aniq vazifalar va o'lchovli natijalarni (masalan, 10 kg mushak massasi, 5% yog' miqdorini kamaytirish) belgilash.

roadmap_steps.title: Jismoniy holatni baholash
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Baza testlari (kuch, chidamlilik, moslashuvchanlik) va tana tarkibi tahlili o'tkazish.

roadmap_steps.title: Dastur tuzish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Kuch, hajm va kardio elementlarini o'z ichiga olgan 12‑haftalik trening rejasini yaratish (haftada 4‑5 kun).

roadmap_steps.title: Ozuqa rejasini ishlab chiqish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Kalkulyator yordamida kunlik kaloriya, makroelementlar (protein 2 g/kg, yog' 0.8 g/kg, uglevodlar) miqdorini belgilash, oziq-ovqat ro'yxati tuzish.

roadmap_steps.title: Progress monitoring
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har 2‑haftada vazn, tana a'zolari, kuch ko'rsatkichlari va fotosuratlar orqali natijalarni qayd etish.

roadmap_steps.title: Dasturga moslashish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Natijalarga qarab og'irlik, hajm, intensivlik yoki ovqatlanish miqdorini o'zgartirish, platlolarni yengish.

roadmap_steps.title: Yordamchi odatlarni shakllantirish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Uyqu (7‑9 soat), suyuqlik iste'moli (≥3 L), stressni boshqarish va muntazam cho'zish.

roadmap_steps.title: Davomiylik va saqlash
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Maqsadingizga erishgandan so'ng, saqlash fazasini (maintenance) belgilab, dastur va ovqatlanishni barqaror usulda davom ettirish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 1: Asosiy so'z boyligini kengaytirish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har kuni 20 yangi so'zni o'rganish, ularni kontekstda ishlatish va fonetikani mashq qilish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 2: Fonetik va talaffuz mashqlari
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har kuni 15 daqiqa audio material (podkast, YouTube) tinglash, so'zlarni takrorlash va o'z ovozingizni yozib tahlil qilish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 3: Oddiy suhbatlarni amaliyot qilish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Haftada kamida 3 marta til almashish do'sti yoki onlayn platformada 5‑10 daqiqa suhbatlashish, kundalik mavzularni tanlash.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 4: Grammatika asoslari va gap tuzilishi
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har hafta bir taqdimotga asoslangan qoidani o'rganish, misollar yozish va qisqa dialoglar yaratish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 5: Tinglash va tushunish ko'nikmalarini mustahkamlash
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har kuni 10‑15 daqiqa qisqa videolar yoki hikoyalarni tomosha qilish, asosiy mazmunni yozma ravishda qisqacha bayon etish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 6: O'zaro baham ko'rish va teskari aloqa olish
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Har ikki haftada o'z yozma va og'zaki ishlaringizni o'qituvchi yoki til hamkoridan tahlil qilish, xatolarni tuzatish.

roadmap_steps.title: Bosqich 7: Real hayotda qo'llash
roadmap_steps.subtitle: Oy oxirida ingliz tilida 30 daqiqalik mavzuli prezentatsiya yoki roll-play tayyorlash, natijani yozma va audio shaklida saqlash.
